proof:
Source: parent step 9(a) (dilation invariance of the tangent planes); the representation R_r of the parent is replaced by the accepted measure-scaling lemma, which gives the same consequence H^n(M Δ rM) = 0. Notation: μ := R.measure = θ·H^n⌞M, H^n := μHE[n], λ•S := {λz : z ∈ S}. Since θ ≥ 1 on M, H^n(M ∩ S) ≤ μ(S) for Borel S; μ(Mᶜ) = 0; μ ≪ H^n⌞M. For λ > 0 the map z ↦ λz is a homeomorphism, so λ•S is Borel when S is.
1. (Measure scaling.) By `Submission.cone_current_imrep_measure_smul_image`, μ(λ•A) = ofReal(λ^n)·μ(A) for every λ > 0 and Borel A.
2. (M and λ•M agree up to H^n-null sets.) Let λ > 0. Since z ↦ λz is a bijection, M ∖ λ•M = λ•(λ⁻¹•M ∖ M); by step 1, μ(M ∖ λ•M) = ofReal(λ^n)·μ(λ⁻¹•M ∖ M) ≤ ofReal(λ^n)·μ(Mᶜ) = 0, so H^n(M ∖ λ•M) ≤ μ(M ∖ λ•M) = 0 (a Borel subset of M). Applying this to λ⁻¹ gives H^n(M ∖ λ⁻¹•M) = 0, and by the scaling of Hausdorff measure (Mathlib `MeasureTheory.Measure.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_smul₀`: H^n(λ•S) = λ^n·H^n(S)) H^n(λ•M ∖ M) = H^n(λ•(M ∖ λ⁻¹•M)) = λ^n·0 = 0.
3. (Good points.) Let B := {z : ¬(z ∈ M ∧ ∃ Q', HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M z Q')}. The field `orients` of R gives (H^n⌞M)-a.e. an approximate tangent space, so the set of z ∈ M without one is (H^n⌞M)-null, hence μ-null (μ ≪ H^n⌞M); together with μ(Mᶜ) = 0, μ(B) = 0. Choose a Borel E ⊇ B with μ(E) = 0 (MeasureTheory.exists_measurable_superset_of_null). By step 1 with λ := r⁻¹, μ(r⁻¹•E) = ofReal(r^{−n})·μ(E) = 0, and {x : r x ∈ E} = r⁻¹•E. Hence for μ-a.e. x: x ∉ E and r x ∉ E, i.e. x ∈ M, r x ∈ M, and M has approximate tangent spaces at x and at r x.
4. (Comparison at such x.) Fix such x; let Q_1 := approxTangentPlane n M x and Q_2 := approxTangentPlane n M (r x). Since approximate tangent spaces exist at x and r x, the definition of approxTangentPlane (a choice of one of them) gives HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q_1 and HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M (r x) Q_2.
(i) `Submission.dtc_approxTangent_dilation` with base point 0 and scale r⁻¹: dilation 0 r⁻¹ is z ↦ −((r⁻¹)⁻¹•0) + (r⁻¹)⁻¹•z = r z, so its image of M is r•M and it maps x to r x; hence HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (r•M) (r x) Q_1.
(ii) `Submission.dtc_approxTangent_of_null_diff` with M' := M ∩ r•M ⊆ r•M and V := univ (open, containing r x): H^n((r•M ∖ (M ∩ r•M)) ∩ univ) = H^n(r•M ∖ M) = 0 by step 2; so HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (M ∩ r•M) (r x) Q_1.
(iii) The same lemma with M' := M ∩ r•M ⊆ M and V := univ: H^n(M ∖ (M ∩ r•M)) = H^n(M ∖ r•M) = 0 by step 2; so HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (M ∩ r•M) (r x) Q_2.
(iv) By uniqueness of approximate tangent spaces (SimonGMT `HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt.unique`), Q_1 = Q_2, i.e. approxTangentPlane n M (r•x) = approxTangentPlane n M x. ∎
